name: io.github.moshejs/recall-watch
title: Recall Watch
description: One firm's FDA record: warning letters, Form 483 citations and recalls since 2012, with FDA links.

environmentVariables.name: OPENFDA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free openFDA API key (open.fda.gov/apis/authentication). Without one, openFDA allows 1,000 requests a day per IP; each lookup makes 3.

environmentVariables.name: FDA_DASHBOARD_USER
environmentVariables.description: FDA Data Dashboard API user (the Authorization-User FDA issues). Set it with FDA_DASHBOARD_KEY to turn on Form 483 citations.

environmentVariables.name: FDA_DASHBOARD_KEY
environmentVariables.description: FDA Data Dashboard API key (the Authorization-Key FDA issues). Without both dashboard variables, citations come back NOT CONNECTED.

environmentVariables.name: CONTACT_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL named in the User-Agent sent to FDA. Default: https://recall-watch.quentin.software

environmentVariables.name: SITE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base for the links back to the Recall Watch site in each answer. Default: https://recall-watch.quentin.software
